subject: QBR + technical demo — executive sponsor alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Alex —

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. As discussed, we’d like to schedule a combined QBR + product demo the week of April 13 so we can:
- Walk through usage / cost trends and highlight optimization opportunities
- Do a 30–40 minute technical demo with our SE so your engineers and security team can validate the integration
- Align on next-step commitments and executive sponsorship for any cross-team procurement work

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 14 Apr 1:00–2:00pm
- Wed 15 Apr 10:30–11:30am
- Thu 16 Apr 3:00–4:00pm

Please let me know which works best and whether your VP of Engineering (or another exec sponsor) will join — having them on for the last 15 minutes to confirm business objectives helps prioritize any procurement timeline. I’ve attached a draft QBR agenda.

Attaching: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cassandra Lee <cass.lee@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Marissa —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. A couple notes from our side:
1) Procurement needs to be on a separate sync to go over contract timelines and SOW items; they can join the QBR but will want a follow-up procurement call.
2) Security and our infra engineers want to be on the demo (especially the SE deep-dive). Can you include an item for data residency and audit logs?
3) Michael Torres (VP Eng) is available the week of the 20th only — he can do Tue/Wed afternoons (after 1pm PT). He asked if we could push the exec portion to the following week, but wants an initial technical demo earlier so his eng managers have time to review.

Of the slots you sent, Thu 16 Apr 3pm PT would work for our engineers/security, but if Michael needs the 20th week for exec time we can do the demo on the 16th and then schedule a 30-min exec alignment on the 21st.

Can your SE do Thu 16 Apr 3pm PT? Also, Dev/Marissa — can you confirm the security checklist items?

Thanks,
Alex
Principal Program Manager, AcmeCorp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Marissa / team —

I can take the exec alignment piece if needed, but I think it’s better to have Michael hear from an AE + VP-level owner. Looping Laura (CS) in case they want post-demo enablement.

Dev — can you confirm if Thu 16 Apr 3:00–4:00pm PT works for you to do the deep-dive (security, KV caching, prefix caching, and integration)? Also calling out time zones: Alex’s team is PST; our SEs are PST/EST split — if we confirm, please specify if you need to pre-send slides or logs.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive (on rotation)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Jonas / Marissa —

16 Apr 3pm PT works for me. I’ll prepare a 35-minute technical demo covering:
- Integration architecture and auth patterns (KMS/HSM options)
- Data residency & audit logs (will surface retention policies and where logs are stored)
- Performance profile & batching recommendations for their workload
- Live integration walkthrough and Q&A with engineers

Can you send me a short list of the security questions they want addressed so I can bring logs/config snippets. Attaching our standard security checklist for their team to review.

Attaching: security_checklist.xlsx

—
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Cassandra Lee <cass.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Alex / Cassandra —

Great — we’ll confirm Thu, 16 Apr 3:00–4:00pm PT for the technical demo with Dev running the deep-dive. I’ve updated the agenda to add a 15-minute security/audit logs section and a 10-minute timeboxed open Q&A.

Per your note on exec alignment, how does Tue, 21 Apr 1:30–2:00pm PT look for Michael Torres and your procurement lead to join a brief exec-level alignment (goals, procurement timeline, approvals)? If that time is tight, we can also do Tue 21 Apr 3:00–3:30pm PT. Jonas, I’ll let you take point on the exec call if Michael prefers to talk directly to a sales leader.

I’ve attached the updated QBR agenda and a short pricing summary for Procurement to review in advance. I’ll send a calendar invite once Alex confirms both slots.

Attaching: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf; acme_pricing_summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — proposed times and ask for exec sponsor

Marissa / Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up. I can do Tue, 21 Apr 1:30–2:00pm PT. Please keep the exec alignment focused: 10 minutes on business outcomes + 10 minutes on procurement timeline / next steps. I won’t need to attend the full technical demo but would like the notes afterward.

—
Michael Torres
VP, Engineering — AcmeCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmecorp.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + technical demo — confirmed: technical demo 16 Apr; exec alignment 21 Apr

All —

Confirmed:
- Technical demo: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 | 3:00–4:00pm PT (Dev Patel running technical deep-dive; engineers/security from Acme to join)
- Exec alignment: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 | 1:30–2:00pm PT (Michael Torres, Procurement, Acme execs; Jonas/Marissa to attend)

Calendar invites sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234 — please accept. We’ve also uploaded the agenda and pricing summary to the shared drive for your procurement review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqzQBR

Next steps for Acme: 1) Review security_checklist.xlsx and flag any items you want Dev to cover live; 2) Procurement to confirm SOW items before the exec call; 3) Michael — we’ll send a 1-page outcomes doc ahead of the exec alignment.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the demo.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
